requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml for full stack startup
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml, so that the product can be launched and verified for real.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When a test invokes the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK status, satisfying the QA coverage rule.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time to <1 minute

requirements: R1: Implement updating and deleting of existing epidemiological materials in the UI by invoking the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoints.

slices.title: Add edit and delete actions to materials UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI to support update and delete, so that materials can be kept up to date.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the UI, When a user edits and saves it, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint and the view updates.
Given an existing material in the UI, When a test clicks delete, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and removes it from the view, satisfying the QA coverage rule.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated material retention to 0 days

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.tocConstraintRef: System security and access control bottleneck
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing or modifying the catalog by prompting them to log in.

slices.title: Implement authentication block on catalog routes
slices.jtbd: When implementing security for this epic, I want to patch existing routes to require authentication, so that unauthorized access is prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user in automated tests, When the test attempts restricted access, Then the test verifies the blocking mechanism, satisfying the QA coverage rule.
